name: ThreatIntel AI Engine
description: Evidence-first threat intelligence investigation engine. Supports CVE investigations using NVD, CISA KEV, Red Hat Security Data API, and OSV, with source correlation and comparison over time. Provides vendor-specific product impact assessments and retrieval of previously persisted investigation context.

watchEnabled.description: Run scheduled watchlist monitoring in the gateway. Off by default.

watchNotifyTarget.description: Discord target for watch alerts, for example channel:123456789012345678. Without it, changes are saved but not sent.

watchTickMinutes.description: How often the monitor looks for due checks and pending alerts.

watchDefaultIntervalHours.description: Default hours between checks of a watched CVE.

watchMaxEntries.description: Most CVEs the watchlist may hold.

watchDeliveryMode.description: direct: this plugin's outbox owns retries (default). openclaw_queue: OpenClaw's delivery queue owns retries once it holds an alert.
